prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: original square World of Warcraft addon project icon for Second Wind, matching the supplied sibling-addon raster logos.
Input images: Image 1 (Lorekeeper's Codex) and Image 2 (Explorer's Field Journal) are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. Match their hand-painted fantasy inventory-item artwork, bold chunky forms, vivid angular brushstrokes, richly textured surfaces, luminous golden metal highlights, deep inky navy vignette, strong readable silhouette and polished illustrated finish. Create a new subject; do not copy their books, star, quill or paw medallion.
Subject: a single stout battle-worn kite shield, upright in a slight three-quarter view, with a broad chunky gold rim and dark frost-blue steel face. It has a few large readable dents and slashes from a hard fight but is still standing. A small brilliant amber ember shaped like a simple flame burns at the centre. Two broad luminous ice-blue wind ribbons curl around the shield in one graceful rising spiral, suggesting a fresh breath and renewed resolve after a near-fatal fight. The shield is the dominant large solid shape, with the wind a clear supporting gesture. This is for a combat debrief addon named Second Wind, meaningful for every character class and faction.
Composition: centred, square, close-up fantasy item icon; the shield and wind together fill about 85% of the canvas with every edge visible. Spacious enough to read at 32–64 pixels, few large shapes, excellent contrast. Same visual family as the references. Bold painterly texture, thick golden bevels, warm amber centre against cold blue metal and cyan wind, restrained background.
Constraints: opaque full-bleed deep navy square background; no text, letters, wordmark, watermark, outer frame, rounded app tile, photorealism, flat vector art, interface panel, charts, medical cross, characters, book, swords, scenery, extra props, tiny scattered sparkles or busy filigree. No faction crests or class-specific symbols. Only one finished icon, no sheet, no mockup.
